IsInJumpWindow.name: Lift.IsInJumpWindow
IsInJumpWindow.statement:
abbrev IsInJumpWindow (η : ℕ) (ε : ℤˣ) (b W : ℕ) (U : Finset ℤ) := ∀ u ∈ U, -η ≤ u ∧ u ≤ η ∨
  ε.1 = 1 ∧ b ≤ u ∧ u ≤ b + W ∨ ε.1 = -1 ∧ b ≤ -u ∧ -u ≤ b + W

raisedAtE.name: Lift.raisedAtE
raisedAtE.statement: @[grind] def raisedAtE (t : ℤ) a u := ite (a = 0) t 0 - u

twoWindows.name: Lift.twoWindows
twoWindows.statement: noncomputable abbrev twoWindows (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ) := Icc (-↑n) ↑n ∪ Icc (i - n) (i + n)

NoMultipleNear.name: Lift.NoMultipleNear
NoMultipleNear.statement: def NoMultipleNear (p n : ℕ) b := ∀ y ∈ twoWindows n b ∪ twoWindows n (-b), ↑p ∣ y → y = 0

sumtwoWindowsle.name: Lift.sum_twoWindows_le
sumtwoWindowsle.statement:
lemma sum_twoWindows_le {n p d} {c : ℤ} (m H : ℕ) (e : n ≤ p * m) (hH : |c| + n ≤ H) :
    (twoWindows n c).sum (padicValInt p · + d) ≤ (4 * m + 2) * p.log H + (4 * n + 2) * d

taupowsmulmemainfLatticeofchi.name: Lift.KummerChart.JumpLattice.tau_pow_smul_mem_ainfLattice_of_chi
taupowsmulmemainfLatticeofchi.statement:
lemma Lift.KummerChart.JumpLattice.tau_pow_smul_mem_ainfLattice_of_chi (c : ℕ) {x i} (hx :
  x ∈ L.withExponents i (stdExponent 0)) (hc : ∀ g x, L.ρ g x =
  χ g ^ (c : ℤ) • x := by simp) : tau ^ c • x ∈ L.ainfLattice

binders.name: hc
binders.type: ∀ g x, L.ρ g x = χ g ^ (c : ℤ) • x

constantAt.name: Lift.KummerChart.PairingSide.constantAt
constantAt.statement:
noncomputable def constantAt : S.C →ₗ[ℤ_[p]] S.trivLattice.Ambient :=
  (S.trivLattice.letterProj i).restrictScalars _ ∘ₗ DiagTensor.mk (ρ := .of _) 1

liftIdeal.name: Lift.KummerChart.PairingSide.liftIdeal
liftIdeal.statement:
noncomputable def liftIdeal (S : PairingSide O) (r l : ℕ) i :=
  span {↑r} ⊔ ((withExponents i (stdExponent l)).map (S.projTriv.wittMap.restrictScalars _)).colon
  (S.trivLattice.ainfLattice.map ((letterProj i).restrictScalars _))

KillsCokernel.name: Lift.KummerChart.PairingSide.KillsCokernel
KillsCokernel.statement: def KillsCokernel (S : PairingSide O) i (κ s : ℕ) := ↑(p ^ κ * k.E ^ s) ∈ S.liftIdeal 0 0 i

memliftIdealiff.name: Lift.KummerChart.PairingSide.mem_liftIdeal_iff
memliftIdealiff.statement:
lemma mem_liftIdeal_iff : s ∈ S.liftIdeal r l i ↔ ∃ t, ∀ c, ∃ x ∈ S.extLattice.withExponents i
  (stdExponent l), S.projTriv.wittMap x = (s - r • t) • S.constantAt i c

ppowmemliftIdealself.name: Lift.KummerChart.PairingSide.p_pow_mem_liftIdeal_self
ppowmemliftIdealself.statement: lemma p_pow_mem_liftIdeal_self : p.cast ^ κ ∈ S.liftIdeal (p ^ κ) l i

phipowsmulconstantAt.name: Lift.KummerChart.PairingSide.phi_pow_smul_constantAt
phipowsmulconstantAt.statement:
lemma phi_pow_smul_constantAt c : FrobGroup.φ ^ l • S.constantAt i c = S.constantAt
  ((letterFrob ^ l) i) c

liftIdealleofppowmem.statement:

constantAtmemlocLetterPart.statement: lemma constantAt_mem_locLetterPart c : S.constantAt i c ∈ S.trivLattice.locLetterPart l i

ppowmulzpowmemliftIdealiff.statement:

existsliftofmemliftIdeal.name: Lift.KummerChart.PairingSide.exists_lift_of_mem_liftIdeal
existsliftofmemliftIdeal.statement:

memliftIdealzeroofmemone.name: Lift.KummerChart.PairingSide.mem_liftIdeal_zero_of_mem_one
memliftIdealzeroofmemone.statement:

  ↑(p ^ c * k.z ^ n) ∈ S.liftIdeal r 1 (k.letterFrob i)) (e : c + padicValNat p
  n.factorial ≤ κ + padicValNat p (p * a).factorial) : p ^ κ * k.z.1 ^ a ∈ S.liftIdeal r 0 i

memliftIdealofmulEpow.statement:

existszpowmemliftIdeal.statement:

killsCokernelofisUnramified.statement:

  ↑((p - 3) * (s + t))) (hk : IsUnramified) (hp : 5 ≤ p) :
  S.KillsCokernel i s t

PairingSide.name: Lift.KummerChart.PairingSide
PairingSide.statement:
structure KummerChart.PairingSide (O : Coeffs) extends kerLattice :
  JumpLattice O where (C : GalLattice O Γ) (α : C →ₗ[O] crysCocycles ρ) zero_mem i : 0 ∈ U i

extLattice.name: Lift.KummerChart.PairingSide.extLattice
extLattice.statement:
abbrev KummerChart.PairingSide.extLattice := JumpLattice.mk ⟨_,
  extensionRep S.α⟩ S.U _ ⟨isAdmissible_extensionRep _ S.inClass.1, fun _ _ n ↦ by
  simpa [or_iff_not_imp_left] using S.inClass.2.1 _ _ ∘ ne_bot_of_le_ne_bot n ∘ jump_extension_le
    _, nofun⟩ (insert_subset (S.zero_mem _) <| S.embJumps_subset ·)

trivLattice.name: Lift.KummerChart.PairingSide.trivLattice
trivLattice.statement:
abbrev KummerChart.PairingSide.trivLattice : JumpLattice O :=
  ⟨⟨S.C, 1⟩, fun _ ↦ {0}, _, .of_cyclotomic_pow 0, by simp⟩

projTriv.name: Lift.KummerChart.PairingSide.projTriv
projTriv.statement: abbrev KummerChart.PairingSide.projTriv : S.extLattice.Hom S.trivLattice := ⟨.snd .., by tauto⟩

cost.name: Lift.KummerChart.cost
cost.statement:
def Lift.KummerChart.cost a n := padicValInt p n + (differentExp + 3 * a)

seal WittVector.eval

existsdepthstep.name: Lift.KummerChart.exists_depth_step
existsdepthstep.statement:
lemma Lift.KummerChart.exists_depth_step (hn : n ≠ 0) : ∃ g : galMonoid, ∃ ω : _ˣ, ∃ υ X,
  g • (k.frobE a).1 = ↑ω * k.frobE a ∧ (∀ s : k.S, (k.frobE a).1 ∣ g • s - s) ∧
  (k.frobE a).1 ∣ υ * X - p ^ cost a n ∧ zTau * X = (ω ^ n).1 - 1

existsdepthstepzero.name: Lift.KummerChart.exists_depth_step_zero
existsdepthstepzero.statement:
lemma Lift.KummerChart.exists_depth_step_zero : ∃ t : Fin (p ^ cost a 0) → galMonoid,
  ∀ (g : galMonoid) (s : k.S), (k.frobE a).1 ∣ g • ∑ l, t l • s.1 - ∑ l, t l • s.1

withExponents.name: Lift.KummerChart.JumpLattice.withExponents

  L.Functional →ₗ[BdR] _, (∀ μ n, (∀ t, μ (.mk 1 t) ∈ hodgeFil n) → D μ ∈ hodgeFil (n + κ)) →

  = toGp g • μ (.mk 1 t)) → D μ' = toGp g • D μ) → D μ * ν x ∈ hodgeFil n) : μ x ∈ hodgeFil n

  y ∈ A.withExponents i c') (hx : x ∈ L.withExponents i c) (H : ∀ a, ∀ u ∈ A.U (i.stepBack a),

  wittPairing b y x ∈ C.withExponents i c''
